How to play

Everyone climbs the same endless tower on the big screen. The screen scrolls up on its own — and speeds up. Fall below the bottom and you're out. Last climber on the tower wins.

Controls (phone)

  • Steer: tilt your phone left/right. Tap the steering toggle on your controller to switch to the on-screen D-pad instead — any time.
  • JUMP: hop to the next ledge. There's a little forgiveness if you tap just after leaving a ledge.
  • ATTACK — tap: push the nearest climber in range (the ring on the big screen shows who you'd hit; your button lights up when someone's in range). Pushes deal no damage — knockback only. The fall does the killing.
  • ATTACK — hold: grab that climber instead. While grabbed they can't steer or jump, and you can't jump and steer slower with full hands. Max hold is 2 seconds; let go (or time out) and they're tossed the way you're facing. The grabbed player mashes JUMP to break free faster. Getting burned, spun, webbed, launched or rocked breaks your grip instantly.
  • Push and grab share one cooldown (~1.5s). Fainted climbers can't be pushed or grabbed.

Health

100 HP. Hazards deal damage; health regens at 5% per second — except while you're on fire. At 0 HP you faint for 5 seconds: no control, but regen keeps running, so you wake near 25 HP if the scroll hasn't taken you. Stand still for 7 seconds and you're left behind — a countdown appears over your climber when 5 seconds remain.

On the tower

  • Spring ledges bounce you high.
  • Fans launch you sideways, hard.
  • Sticky webs hold you ~2.5s while the screen rises.
  • Dizzy spores reverse and wobble your steering for ~4s.
  • Fire braziers light you up: ~5 HP/s for ~4s, and no regen while lit.
  • Spiked ledges damage you when you land on them.
  • Falling rocks — a shadow appears first. Move.

Towers

The host picks before the round: Classic (balanced), Lava (more fire and fans), Frost (slippery drifting ledges, more webs). Everything gets faster and meaner the higher the round climbs.
